mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when GDP growth is positive, more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment below 3.5% signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and increasing S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly higher when unemployment is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production and housing starts increase, it indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when both proxies increase, more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher Fed Funds rates increase borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS > 4%, more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment reflects a strong economy, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not higher when unemployment is low, more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation above 3% may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when inflation exceeds 3%, more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in both employment and retail sales indicates strong demand, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when both proxies increase, more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, slowing housing starts may signal an economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive when housing starts slow, more than 50% of the time.
